WITH state_counts AS (
    SELECT c.state_county_province, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
    FROM Customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.state_county_province
), state_shares AS (
    SELECT account_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(account_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
    FROM state_counts
), average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM state_shares
), above_average AS (
    SELECT sc.account_count, ss.share, av.avg_share
    FROM state_counts AS sc
    JOIN state_shares AS ss ON 1 = 1
    CROSS JOIN average_share AS av
    WHERE ss.share > av.avg_share
)
SELECT SUM(account_count) AS combined_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: Customers with no recorded state are grouped together in one NULL state group; each state group's count includes accounts held by its customers, with zero-account customers contributing zero.
